dialogues.speaker: Sage
dialogues.text: Yup! I wanna know what talking to animals is like!

dialogues.speaker: Sage
dialogues.text: Hmm... But I've only seen a guy in green clothes and white socks talk to animals before. Happened to bump into him.

dialogues.speaker: Sage
dialogues.text: I told Mom how awesome he was, but that guy said that I was mistaken.
